summary: Iter 9 testing: focused on the mobile blank-screen fix on Landing + Experience Centre redesign + responsive validation across 8 viewports (320, 360, 390, 414, 768, 1024, 1440, 1920). Backend smoke regression also run (public stats/catalog/categories, auth, VIN passport). Result: 10/10 backend tests pass and ALL 8 viewports show 0px horizontal overflow + 5/5 .reveal sections become .in-view (the blank-screen bug is fixed). All 6 Experience Centre tiles render (ec-tile-day-night, ec-tile-facade-variations, ec-tile-interior-luxe, ec-tile-cafe-wheels, ec-tile-mod-zone, ec-tile-architecture). Theme toggle works without breaking reveals. Ticker is rendering live data from /api/public/stats. CTAs have correct hrefs (Reserve→/inquire confirmed by navigation; Browse all kits→/kits; Sign in→/dashboard; Schedule a kit consultation→/inquire; Visit retail website→external).

minor.endpoint: Inherited from iter8: joy_id counter still produces JOY-1001 for new users; iter8 P0 fix not yet verified (test_iter9_regression only checks format, not uniqueness across users). See iteration_8.json action items.

responsive_validation.blank_screen_bug: RESOLVED — useScrollReveal hook + .reveal default opacity:1 fix verified across all viewports.

action_items: (Carry-over from iter8) P0 — Fix joy_id counter so unique sequential JOY-XXXX is generated per user; do one-time migration for the 2 existing JOY-1001 collisions. Code path: backend/routes/auth_workshop.py L62-70 + L130-141. Replace `$setOnInsert:{start:1001}` + `max(1001, seq)` with `$setOnInsert:{seq:1000}` + plain `int(counter['seq'])`.
critical_code_review_comments: useScrollReveal.js fix is sound — defaulting .reveal to opacity:1 + arming hidden state ONLY after JS confirms IO is wired (via html.js-reveal-armed class) makes the page resilient when JS fails / loads slowly / hook bails. Good progressive-enhancement posture.
Landing.jsx Experience Centre section uses 6 distinct data-testids — all present at all viewports. ExpTile helper is clean and reusable.

Hot reload: index.css line 1-20 setting overflow-x:hidden globally on html/body is a sledgehammer fix; works but masks any future legitimate overflow bug. Consider using `overflow-x:clip` (modern, doesn't create scroll context) and adding a CI lint to flag elements wider than 100vw.
Sign-in CTA in header sits behind a fixed nav at certain scroll positions causing is_visible=False at >0 scroll positions; not blocking but worth z-index/positioning audit.
/api/public/stats `active_now` still uses unset last_seen_at field per iter8 — same minor issue persists (always shows floor of 8).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (responsive, reveals, testids, CTAs hrefs, theme toggle, ticker)
